messages:
Ava: deploy-bot stopped the promote into prod — preflight failed on artifact-verify for service-payments. tagging @Infra-Raj and @SRE-Maya, this is in today's change window.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Promote 9102 BLOCKED: artifact-verify.failed. failing object: s3://artifacts/service-payments/2026-03-23/sha256:deadbeef. verifier: expected sha256=deadbeef computed=deedbeef. retried 2 times.

Tariq: Does this look like a bad multipart upload? we've seen truncated ETag cases when parts uploaded out-of-order.

SRE-Maya: Checking storage logs. The PUT completed with 200 but the multipart-complete returned 200 with etag mismatch to client's computed digest. Could be a client-side stream issue on builder-12.

Infra-Raj: We have two quick unblock options: 1) pin promote to last-good tag (release-2026-03-22-7) which passed earlier, or 2) re-publish the artifact from the build cache and update the manifest. Pin is fastest to keep the change window.

Product-Lily: Product prefers pinning unless the build contains a critical fix. Is there a user-facing bug in the current build?

Ava: current build fixes rounding display in invoices (minor). PM okay with deferring. We'll pin.

Tariq: If we re-publish we must ensure the new object digest matches manifest — that requires updating manifest and possibly CI signature. Might be slower than pin.

SRE-Maya: I'll quarantine the bad object (deadbeef) and open INC-2026-084. Will collect multipart upload IDs and builder-12 logs.

Ava: I'm doing a manual pin to release-2026-03-22-7 now and re-triggering deploy-bot. Adding a release note: "Promotion paused due to artifact mismatch; promoting last-known-good while investigating storage upload inconsistency."

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Manual pin requested by Ava. Promote queued for tag release-2026-03-22-7. Smoke expected in ~3m.

Infra-Raj: I'll snapshot builder-12's artifact cache and extract the original tarball for potential reupload later.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Smoke for release-2026-03-22-7 PASSED. Promote completed.

Ava: Cut done. Follow-up: SRE-Maya to run postmortem and confirm whether to blacklist builder-12 or roll a patch to the uploader. Thanks all.
